[[File:Bleak_Point_Station_TEGTPM.jpg|thumb|250px|Bleak Point Station]]
'''Bleak Point Station''' was a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] station on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. It was used by the [[Theran]]s to prevent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] larger than a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] to escape the planet because they could send the [[Death Seed]] through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Station was [[Bleak Point Invasion|attacked]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] by the [[Newcomer]]s. After the battle, a man was able to throw explosives into the cannon, damaging it. [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] was then able to lift off and flee.
